page: Microsoft Azure L2as_v5 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the Lasv5 family. It is equipped with 2 dedicated vCPUs powered by an AMD processor and runs on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance features 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

For local storage, the L2as_v5 includes a bundled 480 GB NVMe SSD. The instance is also Premium Storage capable, allowing for integration with high-performance external storage volumes. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses or GPU hardware.

From a resource density perspective, the combination of dedicated AMD vCPUs, a high memory-to-core ratio, and local NVMe storage provides a balanced profile for workloads requiring fast local read/write operations without the overhead of larger instance sizes. This hardware configuration is suitable for small-scale database hosting, caching layers, and memory-intensive applications that benefit from low-latency local scratch space.
